notes_for_editor: The 1926 entry and the 1934 L-4 cab may describe one site or two; the sources do not settle it. The Idaho staff list has an unlabelled entry between Dennis and Hanna, which we left out. The record already carries the Idaho construction photo; no new photos found. Other Peggy Peak names in the dataset are not this lookout.
